meta.title: Private answers about your body, on WhatsApp
meta.description: SafeSiso is a free, confidential WhatsApp service for adolescent girls in Northern Ghana. Ask anything about your body, your relationships and your health. No registration, no real name, no location.

hero.trustHeadline: Completely private. No judgment. No name needed.
hero.supporting: SafeSiso answers your questions about your body, your relationships and your health — on WhatsApp, day or night.
hero.mission: We are here so that every girl in Northern Ghana can get an honest answer to the questions she is afraid to ask out loud — and, if she needs more than an answer, a safe place nearby that is ready to help.
hero.conversationLabel: An example of what a SafeSiso conversation looks like
hero.conversationDisclaimer: An illustration, not a real conversation. Real chats are never shown to anyone.

conversation.text: hi i want to ask something but im scared
You're safe here. You don't have to tell me your name, and nobody else can see this chat. Ask me anything.
my period is 2 weeks late what does it mean
Thank you for trusting me with that. A late period can happen for a few reasons — stress, illness, a change in weight, or pregnancy. Can I ask you a couple of questions so I can help you properly?

anonymity.heading: You never have to say who you are
anonymity.body: SafeSiso was built so that the question of who you are never comes up. There is nothing to sign up for and nothing to prove.

points.title: No registration
points.body: There is no form, no account and no password. You just send a message.

points.title: No real name
points.body: You are never asked for your name, and you never have to give one.

points.title: No location
points.body: You are never asked where you live. If you are offered a safe space, you choose whether to go.

anonymity.note: SafeSiso is free to use. You only pay for the small amount of mobile data WhatsApp uses.
anonymity.writeHowYouLike: Write however you like. Short messages, mixed languages and spelling mistakes are all fine — SafeSiso is built to understand them.

process.heading: How SafeSiso works
process.intro: Three things happen quietly in the background, so that asking a question is the only thing you have to do.

steps.title: Confidential AI-powered SRH chat
steps.body: Ask anything about your body, periods, relationships, consent, pregnancy or abuse. You get a clear, calm answer in plain language — any hour of the day.

steps.title: Automated red-flag detection
steps.body: SafeSiso pays attention to signs that you may be in danger or distress, not just to the words you use. It is designed to notice when a girl needs more than information.

steps.title: Real-time SafeHer referral
steps.body: If you need more help, SafeSiso connects you to a verified safe space near you that has said it can take you right now.

process.cta: See exactly what happens, step by step

cards.title: Checked by a health expert
cards.body: A contracted sexual and reproductive health expert reviews and approves the information SafeSiso gives before it ever reaches a girl.

cards.title: Never sent to a closed door
cards.body: SafeHer partners keep their availability up to date, so you are only ever referred to a safe space that can actually receive you.

cards.title: Anonymous by design
cards.body: Anonymity is not a setting that can be switched off. Identifying information is never collected in the first place.

cards.title: There at night
cards.body: SafeSiso answers twenty-four hours a day, including the hours when there is no adult you can safely ask.

impact.heading: What this pilot is aiming for
impact.intro: SafeSiso has not launched yet, so there are no results to report. Rather than show numbers that look real but are not, here is what the pilot has committed to achieve.

targets.label: girls reached in the first month after launch
girls reached across Northern Ghana by the end of 2026
verified SafeHer safe space partners across the three northern regions

impact.note: Live figures will replace these targets on the Impact page once the pilot is running. Everything published there is anonymized and aggregated — no conversation content, and no detail that could identify a girl, will ever appear.

finalCta.heading: You can ask SafeSiso anything
finalCta.body: No name. No judgment. No record of who you are.
finalCta.reassurance: If you are not ready yet, that is completely fine. SafeSiso will be here whenever you are.
